prose: Mark Gober returns to InnerVerse to discuss his newest book, An End to the Upside Down Cosmos, rethinking the foundational theories of modern physics. We discuss how cosmology fits into the scientific Tower of Babel, tackle the lack of images of Earth from alleged outer space, question space agency frauds and the moon landing hoax, dissect the problems with dark matter, dark energy, gravity, special relativity, and more…
ext: You'll learn about heliocentrism and the Copernican principle, do-it-yourself observations that refute the globe hypothesis, magnetic declination and other southern hemisphere anomalies, and geocentric astrology.
